purpose: Test whether the frozen FaaSRank exploitation score becomes a faithful NSESche middle-load operational profile when both policies use the same parent-complete ready frontier.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E130-E134 are fresh development seeds declared before capture. E115-E119 and all earlier development cohorts are closed; E120-E129 remain sealed confirmation seeds.

diagnostic_basis.interpretation: V41a did not embed the baseline policy because it scored unscheduled descendants before their parents completed. V42 changes only the opt-in player frontier and reuses the same outcome-blind frozen exploitation score.

frozen_middle_thresholds_from_e11_e20.comparison_design: Unpaired development thresholds from the already verified formal E11-E20 block; no baseline reruns are performed.

candidate.definition: Collect only functions whose parents are complete, then use the frozen deterministic FaaSRank exploitation score for unrestricted initialization and the existing paper-utility indifference tie-break.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit plan before capture; capture all five tapes; build all five state-matched references; run all five online processes; pass QC and pairing; then reveal throughput and QPR.

selection.gate: The five-run mean fixed-window throughput must strictly exceed 1.1348 and both finite-only and zero-completion-as-zero QPR means must strictly exceed 0.06737767485902856 and 0.060639907373125704 respectively.

next_confirmation.closure_requirement: Frozen low, middle, and high NSESche profiles must each strictly beat the frozen baseline throughput and QPR thresholds on the holdout.
